thread:
Maria Chen: quick follow-up from yesterday's postmortem — we flagged 3 remediation tracks: missing spans (ETL drop), bad aggregation rules, and recurring ETL lag. Need clear owners and timelines before Monday.
Ashwin Patel: I can own the missing-span root cause. Plan: reproduce on staging, add more logging to transformer step, and add a monitoring check. ETA: 48h.
Priya Nair: I'll take aggregation fixes and test coverage. I want to add a unit/regression test for the group-by path that caused the incorrect counts. ETA: EOW (Fri).
Lucas Rivera: I'll own dashboarding/alerts: update span-loss dashboard, add an alert for aggregate divergence >5% over 15m, and add a postmortem monitor. Can do by Thu morning.
Dana (data-platform): Heads-up — schema rollforward might block Priya's patch until Friday morning. I'll coordinate a short maintenance window.
Ashwin Patel: noted. For tracing, I'll add a quick KV-store sanity check in the pipeline and a metric `etl/span_inserts_failed` — infra team, can we get a short retention for the debugging traces?
infra-bot: @Ashwin Patel — dev-traces retention increased to 7 days for your workspace (request id: rb-4521).
Maria Chen: good. Also, recurring pattern: this is the 3rd similar span-drop in 6 months. Suggest we schedule a deeper trend analysis + an ops playbook to reduce MTTR. Who can pair on that?
Priya Nair: I can pair for trend analysis next week. Suggest also adding synthetic requests that exercise the failing group-by path.
Lucas Rivera: +1 on synthetic traffic. I'll add a canary flow into the observability repo and wire it to our CI.
Ashwin Patel: for immediate mitigation, propose we enable prefix-KV-caching fallback in staging then canary to prod if stable. Need infra window.
infra-bot: Can run a controlled canary Tue 10:30 UTC — require approval from Maria and Dana.
Maria Chen: approved for Tue 10:30 UTC canary. Dana, confirm dependency window for schema.
Dana (data-platform): Confirmed — schema lock lifted Tue 09:00-12:00 UTC.
Maria Chen: action items recap (I'll paste into the postmortem doc):
- Ashwin: missing-span RCA + extra logging + metric `etl/span_inserts_failed` — ETA: +48h (194 hours? actually 48h).
- Priya: aggregation bug fixes + regression tests + synthetic test case — ETA: EOW (Fri).
- Lucas: dashboard alerts + synthetic canary flow + CI gating — ETA: Thu AM.
- Dana: coordinate schema window and data-platform checks — dependency for Priya, confirmed Tue 09:00-12:00 UTC.
- Infra: enable trace retention & run canary Tue 10:30 UTC (deploy-bot scheduled).
Maria Chen: also agreed: we create a recurring quarterly incident-pattern review (owner rotation). Volunteers?
Lucas Rivera: I'll take Q2 review.
Priya Nair: I'll pair for documentation and playbook writeup.
Ashwin Patel: I'll add a quick alert to paging for span drops (pager thresholds + runbook link).
Maria Chen: thanks all. I'll update the postmortem doc with these owners + explicit due dates and assign follow-up check-in on Mon 09:30 AM in #incidents. Please update the doc if estimates change.
deploy-bot: Canary job `canary/observability-span-check` scheduled for 2024-05-14T10:30:00Z (id: can-8843).
Priya Nair: added a TODO in the postmortem doc with PR templates.
Lucas Rivera: I'll send PR for dashboard changes by Wed COB for review.
Ashwin Patel: starting the staging repro now, will ping with the logs.
Maria Chen: closing comments — high priority for reducing recurrence and adding regression coverage. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
